tasks_completed.description: Fix selectedAccId null short-circuit at line 1266
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced ternary that gates on edAcc presence with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call pattern that checks editorSelections first, then falls back to edAcc.selected_option_id. Now returns non-null when slot has AI selection regardless of edAcc nullity.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: selectedAccId returned null when edAcc was null, making dragOptionId=null and draggable=false. Fix mirrors the identical pattern already used at line 1307 (badge computation).

tasks_completed.description: Fix accommodation drop-target isGated at line 1316
tasks_completed.changes: Changed isGated from `!edAcc || edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder || edAcc.skipped` to `(!edAcc && !selectedAccId) || (edAcc && (edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder || edAcc.skipped))`. Now allows drops when selectedAccId is non-null even if edAcc object is null.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: isGated=true purely because !edAcc blocked candidate drops on AI-selected slots. Skipped/late_arrival_placeholder guard is preserved.

tasks_completed.changes: Regenerated HTML via generate-html-interactive.py for both active plans and deployed to /var/www/travel (nginx travel-web container at port 8094) via deploy-travel-plans.sh.
tasks_completed.rationale: Template changes must be embedded in static HTML for the nginx-served plans. Verified fix presence in deployed /var/www/travel/china/2026-04-12/index.html (5 occurrences of the two fix strings).

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; original code never handled null-edAcc in selectedAccId draggable path
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: selectedAccId ternary at line 1266 short-circuited to null when edAcc was null, making dragOptionId=null||null=null and draggable=false for AI-selected accommodation cards. isGated at line 1316 also returned true on !edAcc alone.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: selectedAccId now resolves from editorSelections first (regardless of edAcc), mirroring the pattern at line 1307. isGated now only gates on explicit skipped/late_arrival states, not on edAcc nullity alone.
